name: AL Language DotNet Interop Tests
brief: OnPrem-target coverage for AL surfaces that a Cloud-target app cannot even declare (DotNet interop). Split out from AL Language Coverage Tests because a Cloud app may not declare a `dotnet` block at all -- see #2641 / StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Runner#2576.
description: Executable proof that AL's DotNet-interop surface works correctly against a real BC instance, on OnPrem target where AL0185 does not apply. Depends on AL Language Coverage Tests for its Assert codeunit (public, no internalsVisibleTo needed). Designed to run against a local BC Docker container, not the AL Runner.
